input.quote:
18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.</quote>
<parameter name="rationale">Section 18 is a full insurance clause that meets every preferred element: CGL at USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional E&O at USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability at USD 5,000,000 (unconditionally, so the Customer Data condition is satisfied given Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data). Section 18.2 provides certificates of insurance on request, and adds favourable extras (primary coverage, notice of cancellation, no limitation of Vendor liability). No redline is warranted; this sits at or above our preferred position.</rationale>
<parameter name="confidence">0.95
